 Seungri, a former member of the group Big Bang, once again stunned the public.
 In a series of quiet private lives and constant gossip, he caught the public off guard by delivering unexpected news at the same time: "Pregnancy and marriage."
 According to a report by "Gray News" on the 27th, Seungri's lover in her 20s is currently pregnant with a child and is expecting a child in January next year.
 사진 확대 Seungri, a former member of the group Big Bang, once again stunned the public. Photo = Reporter Chun Jung-hwan The two have already set up a honeymoon house in Gangnam, Seoul, and are reportedly planning to hold a ceremony after the birth of a new life.
 In particular, how the news was revealed to the surface leaves a strange lingering impression. Rumor has it that the media came across the birth while covering Seungri's recent alleged special assault.
 At the time, Seungri was reported to have expressed a significant feeling during the interview, saying, "I have a family to protect." This is the news of the second generation, which came out of a chaotic situation that has been rumored to be in legal battle over the recent controversy over the price of soju bottles.
 Seungri, who was kicked out of the entertainment industry in 2019 as he was at the center of the "Burning Sun incident" that caused a stir in society. Since then, even after he was released from prison after serving a year and a half in prison on nine charges, he has been criticized for his actions that are far from self-reflection, with sightings of overseas clubs flowing out.
 The news of premarital pregnancy, which erupted in the middle of legal disputes and rumors, coincides with his past moves, which have always shocked the public with incidents that exceeded their expectations.
 This is why the cynical sigh of "It's definitely like a victory" comes out naturally. Attention is focusing on what kind of wedding he will have in the cold eyes of public opinion.
 [Jin Joohee, MK Sports Reporter]
